r10j-v50-campaign-v4.coverage_adequacy: R10J campaign v1 uses the same production launcher, worker, native adapter, complete capture, cold replay, finite evaluator and publication for a fresh seed-40200 pair and, only after the separate committed authority, six held-out cells. Only seed and role select the preregistered prefix fixture; no controller, DLL, task threshold, ramp/hold budget, walking arithmetic or stop change. The original v1 launcher refusal remains unchanged. The repaired production route must pass a fresh complete pair before freeze; component replay does not substitute for that prerequisite. A full finite horizon is needed to exercise the late readiness dwell, every planned foot cycle, the 120-command stop, native session finalization, complete report and independent publication. Shorter smoke cannot cover those late code paths. One development seed with both fresh roles covers these named risks; it gives no held-out, robustness, cross-engine or continuous-coverage evidence. Campaign v2 preserves the consumed 8637f698 zero-world refusal. The measured-body native fixture now receives the exact stage-selected candidate explicitly, and both role suites check its returned profile identity. Campaign, worker, reader and authority bindings select this distinct v2/v4 source revision. No controller, DLL, physical thresholds, ramp, hold, walking schedule or held-out population change; no physical world opened in the failed gate. Campaign v3 preserves the f7b16c23 development pair as invalid: both complete native replays passed, but the original campaign reader refused float-valued declared seed metadata. The worker now publishes only its validated seed identity with integer types through the existing authoritative emitter. Cross-language controls cover both development roles, all six held-out envelopes, malformed seed refusals, unchanged declarations and unchanged measured values. The strict reader and original reports remain unchanged. Core, DLL, controller, task thresholds, ramp and hold budgets, walking schedule and held-out population remain unchanged. A fresh complete production pair after this final publication change is required. Campaign v4 preserves the v3 partial zero-world gate stopped at 79 checks before any physical claim. Cold header review found the smoke report lacks top-level seed_label and seed_sha256 required by the next original campaign reader predicate. Publish both fields from the validated seed identity. Extract the existing complete campaign retention predicates unchanged and exercise that actual validator against native emitted headers and missing-field controls. Preserve the prior physical invalid pair, strict comparisons, controller, DLL, task criteria, ramp/hold budgets, and unobserved six-cell population.
